cognitive_frame: Topic product architecture shaping before any feature cycle is opened: judge whether the topic-level product direction is sound, whether cross-feature capability boundaries and value evolution are visible, and whether downstream feature work can inherit product premises without re-deriving partitions — not whether a single feature's PRD or technical architecture is complete.

expression_conventions.register: analytical product prose; capability narratives may use causal chains; forbid implementation register and single-feature PRD detail
expression_conventions.carriers: diagrams = capability partition / dependency / cross-domain journey (not decoration); tables = compare or enumerate product paths; prose = analysis
expression_conventions.scannability: short items over walls; comparable claims in tables; contrast partitions only when facts already contain the contrast; do not mix direction, boundaries, and milestones in one dense block; present those concerns in separate leaves or blocks rather than one undifferentiated surface
expression_conventions.altitude: topic-level product shaping only — no user-story backlogs, acceptance-criteria matrices, or technical module specs

intent_anchor: all content must be traceable to the upstream decision-doc SSOT; no intents beyond that scope; no enterprise-wide portfolio restructuring unless authorized there; downstream feature cycles inherit topic product structure from this document without guessing capability partitions
audience_type: product leads validating topic direction; stakeholders judging whether a feature cycle may open; reviewers deciding whether shaping is complete — after a clear through-line at milestone granularity, the reader can affirm direction or point to section-level gaps
